SUPERSEDED_FOR_INFERENCE_BY_V2.reason: v1 built donor maps on all 472 samples and passed them into each split, sampled cross-image donors with replacement, and used sample-level paired statistics; v2 fixes these

generalization.definition: cohens_d_gap = (train_mean - val_mean) / pooled_std across the per-sample student metrics of the two splits; parameters = Wt.size + Wv.size

notes.not_task_accuracy: all numbers are internal diagnostics (teacher-target correlation / ranking), never CV-Bench task accuracy
notes.test_discipline: thresholds are module constants fixed before the test split was evaluated; test is diagnostic only

score_reduction_collapse.definition: argmax token per group of the projected-prompt cosine matrix; 'single_argmax_token_fraction' is the fraction of samples whose groups all select one prompt token; 'exact_prompt_invariance_fraction' is the fraction of samples where the correct and same-image other-task student scores are bit-identical

thresholds.DATA_OR_SCHEMA_INVALID: any integrity check fails: sample/image counts, same-image group_mean bytes, teacher_soft sums, projection shapes/finiteness or index hash
thresholds.GENERALIZATION_OVERFIT: best val epoch == 0 (val never improved after initialisation) AND the train listwise KL strictly decreased over the run; the normalised train-val gap is reported alongside
thresholds.STUDENT_PROMPT_COLLAPSE: on val, none of the primary paired deltas (correct - same-image other task, correct - fixed-seed cross-image shuffled) is a present signal on spearman or ndcg_full under signal_present_rule
thresholds.TEACHER_PROMPT_SIGNAL_WEAK: the bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of the teacher prompt/image ranking-change ratio (same-image across-prompt / cross-image same-G donor, Spearman-distance based) is below prompt_signal_ratio_floor
thresholds.signal_present_rule: signal is present iff paired 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND |Cohen's dz| >= effect_size_floor AND two-sided sign-flip permutation p < alpha; otherwise the signal is treated as absent

scope: prompt identifiability / degeneration diagnostic; diagnosis only, no training, no tuning, no model load, CPU only

prompt_embedding.definition: cosine of the mean over prompt tokens of the float16 raw token embeddings; same-image pair = grounding vs pointing of one image; cross-image = fixed-seed donor from a different image

variance.formula: V_image = between-image variance of the per-image mean; V_prompt = within-image across-prompt variance of the per-prompt mean; V_group = within-prompt across-group variance; prompt_signal_ratio = V_prompt / V_image
